content: In case of multiple clients with different PduIDs which are re- questing the same protocol, as all the connections of the same protocol are having the same priority, a second request (with the different RxPduId) will not be processed. If the configuration parameter DcmDslDiagRespOnSecondDeclinedRequest is TRUE, a negative response with NRC 0x21 (BusyRepeatRequest) shall be issued for the second request. If the configuration parameter is FALSE, no response shall be issued.
